claim_boundaries.aabb_envelopes_only: The retained shapes are world.get_bbox-derived axis-aligned boxes and their projected min/max envelopes, not OBBs, exact meshes, silhouettes, segmentation masks, image footprints or object pixels.
claim_boundaries.constructed_reference_only: The constructed correspondent is derived from retained original geometry; it is not a recovered intended fixture array, acceptance target, observed image, counterfactual rollout or independent measurement.
claim_boundaries.no_measurement_or_endpoint_inference: No crop/time mapping, labelability, human annotation, r0/rhat/r endpoint, generated/executed correspondence or A1-A9 result is authenticated.
claim_boundaries.no_visibility_or_occlusion_inference: Positive-depth projected envelopes do not authenticate RGB content, visibility, general occlusion, or robot/static-scene occlusion.
claim_boundaries.science_and_release: No scientific threshold, fixture/camera qualification, current-state inference, gate promotion, dispatch/release authority or new behavioral evidence follows.
claim_boundaries.selection_confounding_and_effects: The three mapping pairs are availability-selected. D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership. No layout, command, model, task-success, population or camera-ranking effect is estimated.

finding: Across nine availability-selected original/reflected object correspondences and their 36 camera projections, camera configurations match exactly across all 12 arm-camera pairs. Relative to a constructed pure center-reflection translation of each original retained AABB, the largest actual reflected bound residual is 1.928526908159256 mm; the largest projected envelope-edge residual is 3.204905157569897 pixels. Both occur for the D02 cube, and no tolerance is applied. D01/D02 are command-confounded and P00 has unequal command membership, so no effect or fixture conclusion is estimated.

reference_semantics.actual_correspondent: Compare that constructed box with the availability-selected actual reflected-arm retained box, then project both through the unchanged retained camera calibration. Residuals use exact stored floats without epsilon, thresholding, fitting, registration or normalization.
reference_semantics.camera_boundary: The four camera configuration objects and hashes are required to match exactly across each original/reflected mapping pair. Per-camera residual summaries are descriptive and do not rank or qualify cameras.
reference_semantics.command_boundary: D01 and D02 compare original-left against reflected-right mappings, so layout arm is command-confounded. P00 contains a shared left command, but its reflected mapping also contains a right-command member. No comparison isolates a layout, command, model or task effect.
reference_semantics.constructed_center_reflection: For each original retained object center (x,y,z), construct the exact robot-base target (x,-y,z). Translate the original retained robot-base axis-aligned box by (0,-2y,0), preserving its original extents. This is a deterministic geometric reference, not an observed target, frozen fixture pose, scientific tolerance or pass/fail predicate.
reference_semantics.orientation_and_settling_boundary: Preserving the original AABB extents represents pure center translation with the original retained box shape. Actual-minus-constructed residuals can mix center settling, orientation settling, axis-aligned-box shape changes and numeric capture; they are not attributed to any one cause.
